news.title: ‘Why do we have to live in fear?’ Residents say repeated gunfire has them afraid in their homes
news.summary: Bullet holes in windows, walls, pillars and even bricks are visible signs of what residents at a DeKalb County apartment complex say has become a persistent and frightening problem.

news.title: Trailblazing Cobb County SWAT deputy dies in North Georgia flooding
news.summary: Julie Ann Barrs of Ellijay died Nov. 5 after floodwaters swept her car away on Old CCC Camp Road in Murray County.

news.title: Family seeks justice after 22-year-old killed in SW Atlanta ambush
news.summary: The family of a 22-year-old mother gunned down in southwest Atlanta is pleading for justice as police search for the man who shot her.

news.title: Midtown salon worker injured confronting customer over $400 tab
news.summary: Atlanta police are searching for a woman who skipped out on a nearly $400 salon tab and fractured a worker's finger.

news.title: Uber driver shot in both legs after dispute over $20 ride
news.summary: An Uber driver drove to an Atlanta police station after a passenger shot him twice during a dispute over a $20 fare.

news.title: Douglas County sexual assault: Man gets life plus 30 years
news.summary: A Douglas County jury convicted Cassius Mikedel Bering Jr. on multiple felony charges following a violent Winston home attack.

news.title: Gang member turns himself in to FBI
news.summary: A wanted fugitive as turned himself in to the Federal Bureau of Investigation in Atlanta, according to the agency.

news.title: Police: Man posed as officer before sexually assaulting woman in Gwinnett County
news.summary: Xavier Anderson is sought by Gwinnett police after posing as an officer to rob and assault a sex worker in January.

news.title: Ted Turner’s daughter pushing his environmental legacy forward after his death
news.summary: Atlanta media mogul and philanthropist Ted Turner was remembered at a private memorial at the United Nations headquarters in New York.

news.title: DeKalb CEO says homelessness alone is not grounds for arrest
news.summary: DeKalb County CEO Lorraine Cochran-Johnson said the county will work to address homelessness while protecting residents’ dignity.

news.title: Gwinnett police seek additional victims in fake cop case
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are asking potential victims to come forward as detectives investigate whether Xavier Anderson may be connected to additional crimes.
